prompt: You are the HOST of Agent Team 'builders' (team-run id tr-123). Roster: member 'kiwi' (member-run id mr-k1, Kimi ACP, currently idle). The user asks you to get this done: add a --json output flag to the 'harness export' CLI subcommand, with a test. Drive this from decomposition to final acceptance. Write out the EXACT sequence of commands and messages you would issue at each step, what you wait on between steps, and what you check before accepting. Assume the harness CLI documented by your skill/context is available.

assertions.text: assigned work uses --claim-mode host_assign together with --owner-member-run-id
completion criteria name verifiable evidence (PR URL / named check / artifact)
waiting uses board-summary or cursors/events, never a sleep-loop poll
acceptance happens only after inspecting artifact/check refs; provider completion alone is not acceptance
request-changes keeps the same member run/session instead of spawning a replacement
